blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.
blocks.zh: 光谱解码是一种流行的解码加速方法. 因此,它与长期产出生成特别相关,这需要越来越多的KV缓存. KV缓存压缩提供了一个在长文本起草中限制成本的方法. 然而,专注于预填信息的压缩方法可能会随着输出长度的增长而失去相关性. 我们用这个现象来形容这个现象,解码固态,并显示它在基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩下会降低模型草稿精度. 我们引入RIFT,这是一组基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩策略,平衡了预填信息和最近生成的符号. 我们显示,在代号生成期间刷新 KV 缓存选择会显著提高起草者的质量,而代价是额外的解码间隔. 为了降低刷新成本,我们提出适应性KV刷新策略,减少计分计算数量,同时保留起草者的质量. 我们进一步证明,在压缩的KV缓存下,一个基于注意力面具的压缩驱动起草器培训阶段如何能够提高起草者的质量。 RIFT与可压缩性训练相结合,使得为Quen3.5-122B起草的Quen3.5-4B能够在32K-token输入,4K-token输出,以及8K-token KV缓存预算上保留超过98%的全缓存接受长度.

blocks.en:
Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by verifying multiple draft proposals in a single target-model pass while preserving the target distribution Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023) , shifting inference towards a compute-bound regime.
Its effectiveness depends on a draft that is both inexpensive and closely aligned with the target.
Reasoning and agentic applications increase the pressure on this balance, combining long input sequence lengths (ISLs) with long output sequence lengths (OSLs) as models generate reasoning traces and accumulate interaction history Nye et al. (2021) ; Yao et al. (2023) .
As context grows, key-value (KV) cache access
can increasingly bottleneck drafting, limiting the achievable speedup from speculation Sadhukhan et al. (2025) .
As a decode acceleration method, speculative decoding targets long OSL, further magnifying the KV cache bottleneck.
This bottleneck is still evident in hybrid attention architectures Dao and Gu (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) : even when only 25% of a small hybrid model’s layers use full attention, its KV footprint can significantly exceed its weights’ memory footprint at long contexts with only a few concurrent requests (See Appendix A for details).
Existing literature considers various forms of KV compression Hooper et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Laus et al. (2026) . Here, we focus on selection-based compression, where decode tokens attend only a compact subset of their past KVs.

blocks.en:
Tail-augmented drafters, e.g., MTP, Eagle or DFlash Li et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) , are considered superior to external draft models on GPU-based deployments due to their minimal latency overhead. However, contemporary hardware-disaggregated inference and edge-assisted serving renews the relevance of small external drafts Aubrey and Ghodsian (2026) ; Park et al. (2025) over tail-augmented blocks, such as MTPs or DFlash Chen et al. (2026) . In these settings, memory capacity poses a constraint, as memory is shared between the model weights and growing KV cache Kim et al. (2026) .
Considering all the above, we study draft KV cache compression under a fixed cache budget that is ISL-independent.
KV compression also enables KV-based self-speculation: the target model itself drafts with a compressed cache and verifies with full cache Sun et al. (2024) ; Sadhukhan et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025) .
Together, these regimes motivate the question: How can we best compress the drafter’s KV cache to sustain target alignment in long contexts?

blocks.en:
We study this question through the trade-off between acceptance length (AL) and the KV cache budget size, measuring drafting quality under a fixed memory constraint.
A fixed KV-budget introduces a tradeoff between KVs selected during prefill and KVs accumulated during decode. Prompt tokens can provide valuable information, while the generated prefix records the target’s recent context. A prefill-based selection becomes stale as generation evolves, while a sliding window (SW) approach limits the model’s view to the latest prefix tokens and discards remote information.
Decode-time refresh of selected KVs allows to adaptively determine the relevant KVs, at the cost of additional latency.
This motivates two complementary approaches: allocate capacity to both prefill positions and generated tokens, and refresh the selected history as relevance changes.

blocks.en:
Our analysis characterizes decode staleness and introduce RIFT ( R ecency– I mportance F usion and T raining), a family of selection-based KV compression strategies combining recency allocation with decode-time refresh of importance-selected context. We further propose compression-aware knowledge distillation (KD) to reduce the training–inference mismatch and improve draft alignment under compression.
Our contributions are: 1. Characterizing decode staleness: We show how prefill selection loses its initial advantage over SWA as generation progresses, and show this gap increases in hybrid-attention models. 2. RIFT: We address decode staleness and propose RIFT, a family of KV compression methods for draft models, balancing implementation complexity with resulting drafting quality. 3. Draft-compressibility training: We develop a knowledge-distillation scheme with compression-driven attention masks to improve draft alignment under a restricted KV budget. Together, our methods retain most of the draft’s acceptance length, while using a fraction of the total KV cache. In SPEED-Bench Abramovich et al. (2026) with 32K ISL and 4 × 4\times compression ratio, Qwen3.5-4B retains up to 96 % \penalty\ 96\% of its full cache AL (Qwen3.5-122B target), and Nemotron3.5-Lightning retains 97 % \penalty\ 97\% of its full-cache AL (Nemotron3-Ultra target), while SnapKV retains 63 − 67 % \penalty\ 63-67\% AL in both cases.

blocks.en:
While prefill-only KV compression has proven beneficial for speculative decoding Sadhukhan et al. (2025) , prior evaluations do not fully reflect long OSLs and modern model architectures.
We start by investigating prefill-based methods in speculative decoding. We use SnapKV to compress the KV cache of Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B and evaluate on SPEED-Bench 32K ISL low entropy split Abramovich et al. (2026) , with reasoning enabled.
As seen in Figure 1 (b), SWA outperforms SnapKV given the same KV budget.
This result is surprising: SnapKV incorporates importance information, while SWA naively keeps a fixed tail of previous tokens. We make the following observations about the KV-compression literature:

虽然只有预填的KV压缩已被证明有利于推测解码Sadhukhan等 (2025),但之前的评价并没有充分反映较长的OSL和现代模型架构.
我们首先调查在投机解码中基于预填的方法. 我们使用SnapKV来压缩Quen3.5-4B的KV缓存,为Quen3.5-122B起草并评价了SPEED-Bench 32K ISL低 en分化Abramovich等 (2026),并启用了推理功能.
如图1(b)所示,在KV预算相同的情况下,SWA的绩效高于SnapKV。
这一结果令人惊讶: SnapKV包含了重要信息,而SWA天真地保留了前作符号的固定尾巴. 我们对KV压缩文学发表以下看法:

blocks.en: KV cache compression benchmarks often overlook long OSL. Evaluations centered on long inputs primarily test which prompt KVs to retain Bai et al. (2024) ; Hsieh et al. (2024) . Regarding decode tokens, one can either 1) retain all generated KVs, 2) maintain a small sliding window alongside the prefill-selected cache, or 3) rescore and update the selection at every decoding step. The tradeoffs between these options become particularly important in speculative decoding, where the draft must remain aligned with a growing target-verified prefix under a fixed KV budget. Retaining all generated KVs violates the budget constraint, while a small sliding window can compromise alignment later in generation (as seen in Figure 1 (a)). Rescoring at every decode step adds significant overhead to the drafting process.
blocks.zh: KV 缓存压缩基准往往忽略了较长的 OSL. 评价以长期投入为中心,主要测试促使KVs保留Bai等人(2024);Hsieh等人(2024)。 关于解码符,人们可以:(1) 保留所有生成的 KV,(2) 在预补选缓存的同时维持一个小的滑动窗口,或者(3) 在每一个解码步骤上重新记录并更新选择。 这些选择之间的取舍在投机性解码中变得特别重要,在这种解码中,草案必须保持与固定的KV预算下越来越多的目标核实前缀保持一致. 保留所有生成的 KV 违反了预算限制,而一个小的滑动窗口可能会在生成后影响调整(见图1(a))。 在每个解码步骤中评分给起草过程增加了可观的间接费用.

blocks.en:
Output-position dependence. We analyze average draft AL across generation positions with an 8 8 K-token budget ( 4 × 4\times compression).
As shown in Figure 1 (a), SnapKV’s AL decreases by 36.7% while SW improves by 41% as generation evolves.
We term the evolving SnapKV-SW difference the staleness gap , which we consider a performance-based proxy for the growing irrelevance of SnapKV’s selected KVs during generation.
We attribute the growth of the staleness gap to two factors. First, in speculative decoding the recent decode prefix is produced by the target model, making access to it highly important for draft-target alignment. Second, recent decode tokens often contain reasoning traces, which potentially act as a running prompt summary Nye et al. (2021) ; Yao et al. (2023) . Indeed, preliminary study shows that disabling reasoning reduces the staleness gap from 2.11 2.11 to 0.60 0.60 AL (See Figure 11 in Appendix C ).

如图1(a)所示,SnapKV的AL下降了36.7%,而随着一代的发展,SW则提高了41%。
我们用SnapKV-SW这个变化来形容停滞差距,
我们把停滞差距的增长归因于两个因素。 首先,在推测解码中,最近的解码前缀由目标模型所出出,这使得获取它对于草稿-目标对接至关重要. 第二,最近的解码符常常会包含推理痕迹,这有可能起到奔跑的即时摘要Nye等 (2021).;姚等 (2023). 事实上,初步研究表明,致残推理减少 (见附录C图11)

blocks.en:
Architecture dependence. We empirically observe that decode staleness is exacerbated in hybrid-attention architectures, which are often overlooked in the KV compression literature.
Due to lack of space, we refer the reader to Appendix C , where we show that 1) a full-attention Llama3.1 draft retains the expected ordering: SnapKV consistently outperforms SWA throughout generation, while, 2) in Nemotron3 (which is hybrid-SSM) and GPT-OSS (which interleaves hard-coded SWA layers with full attention), SWA again outperforms SnapKV.
blocks.zh:
建筑依赖. 我们从经验上观察到,解码固态在混合意向架构中会更形恶化,这在KV压缩文献中经常被忽略.
由于空间不足,我们请读者参阅附录C,我们在该附录中表明,1)全心全意的Llama3.1草案保留了预期的订单: SnapKV在一代人中始终超越SWA,而,2)在Nemotron3(即混合-SSM)和GPT-OSS(将硬码的SWA层相接并充分注意),SWA再次超越了SnapKV.

blocks.en:
Mechanistic evidence. We measure the fraction of the full-cache draft’s attention assigned to positions retained by each policy (SnapKV and SWA), under an 8K budget.
Figure 2 shows that this fraction drops from 67.0 % 67.0\% to 25.4 % 25.4\% for SnapKV, while increasing from 43.5 % 43.5\% to 68.7 % 68.7\% for SWA as generation progresses.
This crossover is consistent with attention shifting toward generated context that the prefill-selected cache largely omits.
blocks.zh:
机械证据. 我们用8K预算衡量对每项政策(SnapKV和SWA)所保留职位的注意。

The SW ratio ρ \rho controls the trade-off between long-range retrieval and recent streaming context.

blocks.en: 4.2 RIFT-dyn: KV Cache Refresh During Decode
blocks.zh: 4.2 RIFT-dyn: (中文(简体) ). 车牌 解码时缓存刷新

blocks.en:
While RIFT-stat introduces gains in the draft AL, its chosen prefill KVs are still selected only once before decode. However, as generation progresses, the relevant prompt KVs dynamically change.
We therefore assume access to the full draft KV cache in HBM or offloaded memory for full KV rescoring.
We propose RIFT-dyn, which iteratively rescores the working KV cache every Δ \Delta decode steps. The resulting working KV cache is a combination of the decode-updated KV cache and the SW component of size ⌊ ρ ​ B ⌋ \lfloor\rho B\rfloor . We focus on SnapKV-based scoring. However, RIFT-dyn is compatible with any alternative KV scoring functions.
RIFT-dyn refreshes the draft’s working memory.
Its effectiveness stems from two main advantages: (i) it scores the entire available KV cache (excluding the SW component), and (ii) it computes scores using a recent observation window, so they better reflect the model’s current state.

因此,我们假定可以访问HBM中KV缓存的完整草稿或卸载的内存,以进行完整的KV回分.

The benefit of adaptive refresh. We compare RIFT-ada with RIFT-dyn’s periodic refresh through their AL–refresh tradeoff, measuring AL gains at matched refresh counts and refresh reductions at matched AL.
The policy triggers a refresh if any of the following conditions holds: acceptance is at or below its threshold, entropy is at or above its threshold, acceptance has fallen or entropy has risen sufficiently relative to post-refresh values, or query drift exceeds its threshold.
As seen in Figure 6 , this policy, which sweeps the query drift threshold, achieves 2.03 × 2.03\times fewer refreshes (or up to + 0.122 +0.122 AL at the same refresh count). We refer the reader to Appendix E for additional settings, parameter-transfer analysis and policy information.

Inspired by recent results in compressibility training of pretrained models Gelberg et al. (2026) , we propose a draft compressibility post-training phase.
Our goal is to minimize the gap between the draft’s working KV cache in training and during inference.
In what follows, we focus on compressibility using attention scores. However, the training method itself is score-agnostic.
The resulting objective promotes target-aligned proposals under a restricted KV budget.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Due to the amount of existing methods, we describe the most closely related work to our methods. We provide a broader discussion of literature in Appendix K . SnapKV estimates prompt importance from observation-window attention and PyramidKV and AdaKV refine allocation across layers and heads Li et al. (2024) ; Cai et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2025b) . These methods optimize which KVs survive compression, while we study how prefill decisions become stale during long generation. Decode-time policies continually adapt the working cache, e.g., StreamingLLM retains attention sinks and recent tokens, while H 2 O combines recent tokens with accumulated-attention heavy hitters Xiao et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023) .
TriForce uses a retrieved target cache as an intermediate drafter, refreshed periodically or by acceptance gating Sun et al. (2024) . MagicDec studies sparse-KV self-speculation at high concurrency. SpecExtend, SparseSpec, and Vegas study how verification can be used for KV cache compression Sadhukhan et al. (2025) ; Cha et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025) ; Yue et al. (2026) . In compressibility training, KV-CAT Gelberg et al. (2026) proposes a continual pretraining phase with a learned KV scoring model.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we identified decode staleness, where prefill-selected context loses relevance as OSL grows, especially in hybrid attention architectures. We show that decode staleness degrades the draft-target alignment in speculative decoding. We proposed RIFT: RIFT-stat combines recency with important prompt positions, RIFT-dyn improves KV selection by rescoring the cache during decode and RIFT-ada allows for adaptive KV rescore to minimize the induced latency overhead. To improve RIFT we propose a compression-aware training phase. Together, our results demonstrate the value of adapting both KV cache selection policies and draft models to retain acceptance lengths under fixed KV cache budgets.
A promising future direction is to combine RIFT’s draft-side staleness signals with target-verification attention, as initial signals show promising results in this direction ( Cha et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2026 , e.g.,) .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们确定了解码固态,其中预补选上下文会随着OSL的增长失去相关性,特别是在混合关注架构中. 我们显示,解码固态在投机解码中会降低草稿-目标对接. 我们提出的RIFT:RIFT-stat结合了Recentity与重要即时位置,RIFT-dyn通过在解码时重评缓存来改进KV选择,RIFT-adada允许适应性KV再计分来将所引发的延迟性间接费用降到最低. 为了改进RIFT,我们建议一个了解压缩的训练阶段。 我们的结果显示,在固定的KV缓存预算中,调整KV缓存选择政策和模式草案以保留接受时间的价值。
一个有希望的未来方向是将RIFT的草稿侧阻滞信号与目标核查注意相结合,因为最初的信号显示这一方向有希望的结果(Cha等,2025;Yue等,2026等).

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
At the time of writing, external draft models generally provide lower end-to-end speedups in GPU-only deployments than tail-augmented drafters such as MTP, EAGLE, and DFlash. Our work is therefore motivated by future heterogeneous systems in which drafting runs on a memory-constrained, SRAM-based accelerator, an emerging direction for which Aubrey and Ghodsian (2026) provides an early signal. In such a system, KV-selection scores could be computed on the GPU using a copy of the draft model, while only the selected KV blocks are transferred to the drafting device. Our evaluation focuses on acceptance-length trade-offs under a fixed active draft KV cache budget. Because decode-time refresh assumes that the full draft KV history remains available in GPU HBM or offloaded memory, this active budget constrains the drafting device’s memory footprint but not the system’s total stored KV memory.
Furthermore, on a GPU setup with naive measurements, we see a relative cost overhead of up to 6.0 % 6.0\% of KV cache rescoring compared to the total draft decode latency. This overhead may become more significant when drafting is accelerated on an SRAM-based device, although its magnitude in disaggregated deployments remains to be measured.
blocks.zh:
在写作时,外部的草稿模型一般在只使用GPU的部署中提供更低的端到端的快取,比起MTP,EAGLE,和DFlash等被尾接的起草器. 因此,我们工作的动力是未来的各种系统,在这些系统中,起草工作以一个内存紧张的、基于SRAM的加速器为动力,奥布里和戈德相(2026年)提供了早期信号。 在这样的系统中,KV选取分可以使用模型草稿的副本在GPU上计算出,而只有所选取的KV块被转移到了起草设备上. 我们的评价侧重于在固定的有效KV缓存预算草案下接受时间的取舍。 由于解码-时间刷新假设在GPU HBM或已卸载的内存中仍然有完整的KV历史草稿,因此这种活性预算限制了起草设备的内存足迹,而并非系统存储的全部KV内存.
此外,在使用天真测量的GPU设置上,我们看到相对成本间接费用高达6.0% 6.0%的KV缓存与总的解码延迟值相比重新评分. 在加速以SRAM为基础的设备的起草工作时,这种间接费用可能变得更加重要,尽管它在分类部署中的规模仍有待衡量。

blocks.en:
We quantify the KV cache footprint in Qwen3.5-4B and
Nemotron-3-Nano (30B-A3B) relative to the combined memory (of weights, KV cache and recurrent states). Concurrent requests share the same weights but retain separate caches. KV memory grows with context length and concurrency while recurrent states (such as SSM and GDN states) grow with concurrency but not with ISL or OSL. We assume bf16 weights and KV entries, fp32 recurrent matrices, and bf16 convolution buffers, giving approximately 49.5 MiB of state per request for Qwen and 47.1 MiB for Nemotron3-Nano.
Figure 8 shows that long-context KV storage
can still dominate. For Qwen3.5-4B, four requests at 64K tokens use 51.1% of the occupied memory, despite only 25% of layers using full attention. Nano’s smaller per-token cache and larger resident weight footprint delay the crossover. Nonetheless, at 256K ISL and 64 concurrent requests, its KV cache accounts for 62.0% of the accounted memory. Consequently, it is clear that the KV memory bottleneck remains evident in standard serving loads.

blocks.en:
We provide additional information on our initial results for KV compression’s effect on MTP. Specifically, we examined Nemotron3-Super’s MTP draft, which went through a post-training phase with a 1K SW. The training used the Nemotron post training V2 dataset, using a standard KD scheme for 10K training steps. The resulting MTP was evaluated on SPEED-Bench 32k and 100k ISL data.
The MTP’s ALs were 4.24 (94% of full KV AL) at 32K ISL and 5.07 (95% of full KV AL) at 100K ISL. Consequently, a simple SWA shows sufficient AL retention in the settings of interest, rendering it a sufficient and simpler option over RIFT for MTPs.
Furthermore, the overall reduction in the system’s TPS due to the MTP’s KV compression was negligible, implying that in a tail-augmented drafting setting, the MTP’s KV cache may not pose as a significant bottleneck compared to external drafting and self-speculation.

MTP的ALs在32K ISL为4.24 (94%为完整的KV AL),而5.07 (95%为完整的KV AL)在100K ISL. 因此,简单的全部门办法表明,在利益环境下保留了足够的AL,使它成为中期计划相对于RIFT的充分而简单的选择。
此外,由于中期计划的KV压缩,该系统的TPS总的减少是微不足道的,这意味着在尾部加固的起草环境中,同外部起草和自我推测相比,MTP的KV缓存可能不会成为一个重大的瓶颈。

blocks.en: Figure 4 in the main paper projects the added rescoring overhead for Qwen3.5-4B with 100K ISL and 4K OSL. For a given refresh interval, we begin by calculating the drafter’s AL under RIFT-dyn with the corresponding refresh interval. Then, we run the speculative decoding loop in vLLM with the corresponding forced AL and a fixed 8K draft KV cache to measure decode latency. We add the estimated vLLM rescoring time for the given interval, and report the added time as a percentage of measured decode latency.

blocks.en: D.3 Block-Size Ablation
blocks.zh: D.3 阻塞大小

blocks.en:
As described in Section 4 , to accommodate real-world serving scenarios, we work with block-level KV cache compression.
We examine the effect of block size on the draft’s performance. We consider Qwen3.5-4B with draft length 11, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B using the SPEED-Bench dataset, 100K and 32K throughput splits. In each setting, we apply RIFT-stat with the corresponding block size.
We consider two generation temperatures and sweep various block sizes. As seen in Figure 15 , when the block size is significantly smaller than the overall KV cache, the effect is negligible. However, each setting has a "critical block size" beyond which the decision space is too coarse and the draft’s performance degrades.
blocks.zh:
正如第4节所述,为了适应现实世界的服务情景,我们采用区块级的KV缓存压缩。
我们审查块大小对草案业绩的影响。 我们考虑使用SPEED-Bench数据集、100K和32K的吞吐分量为Quen3.5-122B起草第11行草案。 在每个设置中,我们应用带有相应块大小的RIFT-stat.
我们考虑两代温度 并扫荡不同的街区大小。 如图15所示,当块大小明显小于总体KV缓存时,效果可忽略不计. 然而,每个设置都有一个"关键块大小",超出这个范围,决定空间太粗糙,草案的性能会退化.

blocks.en:
We evaluate how acceptance changes with OSL on
SPEED-Bench 32K low-entropy data. We force each target response to meet OSL
shown in Figure 14 . In this forced-output setting, the advantage of RIFT-stat over SWA diminishes as OSL grows: their mean-AL gap narrows from 0.42 0.42 to 0.09 0.09 at T = 0 T=0 and from 0.29 0.29 to 0.03 0.03 at T = 1 T=1 between 2K and 64K OSL.
In contrast, the advantage of the decode-level methods grows with OSL.
We note that forcing high OSLs produces highly repetitive generated text, which may affect both the measured ALs and the relative gaps between methods. Thus, the observed trends should therefore be interpreted as results for forced continuations rather than naturally long, meaningful responses.

我们评价对OSL的接受如何改变

相形之下,解码级方法的优势随着OSL而增长.
我们注意到,强迫高的OSL产生高度重复生成的文本,这可能影响到测量的ALS和不同方法之间的相对差距. 因此,所观察到的趋势应被解释为强迫延续的结果,而不是自然而然地长期有意义的反应。

blocks.en: Appendix H Tokenizer Adaptation for Cross-Family Drafting
blocks.zh: 附录H 适应跨家庭起草

blocks.en: We adopt the following tokenizer-adaptation procedure to initialize a cross-family draft before further draft–target alignment: 1. Resize. Resize draft input embeddings and the LM-head to the target’s configured vocabulary size, retaining the draft’s hidden dimension. 2. Copy matching tokens. For each target token, first try a manually role-matched control token (for special tokens). If the token is no a special token, look for an exact match, and if such a match is not found look for a normalized match in the draft vocabulary. 3. Initialize remaining tokens. Retokenize unmatched text with the draft tokenizer and combine up to four embeddings using geometrically decreasing weights. 4. Align outputs. Apply the same mapping to an untied output head, preserve tied embeddings, and adopt the target tokenizer’s beginning-of-sequence, end-of-sequence, and padding IDs. Once the draft’s vocabulary and corresponding embedding matrices are aligned, we perform a knowledge distillation scheme over the Nemotron post-training V2 dataset over 10K steps.

blocks.en: Appendix I Comparison With Additional KV Compression Policies
blocks.zh: 附录一 与额外的 KV 压缩政策的比较

blocks.en:
We provide additional comparisons with KV compression methods, complementing the results in the main paper. We evaluate on SPEED-Bench with Qwen3.5-4B drafting for Qwen3.5-122B and, in Table 17 , Llama3.1-8B drafting for Llama3.1-70B. We consider 4K OSL and a draft length of 11.
We consider the following methods: 1. StreamingLLM Xiao et al. (2024) , which retains a SW of recent tokens together with four initial attention-sink tokens. 2. H 2 O Zhang et al. (2023) , which updates accumulated attention scores at each decoding step and retains a combination of recent tokens and heavy hitters, permanently evicting other positions. 3. TriAttention Mao et al. (2026) , which uses calibrated pre-RoPE query statistics to estimate key importance through RoPE-induced trigonometric distance preferences and norm-based scoring. Specifically, we estimate the mean pre-RoPE query vectors from full-prefill statistics and hold them fixed during decoding, and consider a refresh interval similar to RIFT-dyn of 128 tokens. Tables 17 and 18 show higher AL for RIFT than StreamingLLM across the reported settings.
For the other decode-time baselines, RIFT-dyn and RIFT-ada outperform both H 2 O and TriAttention in every reported setting, while H 2 O generally outperforms RIFT-stat (Table 18 ).

blocks.en:
Masking Strategy We test the gain of the attention-score-based mask by comparing it with similar training runs that use different masking strategies, such as random or SWA-based masks.
As seen in Table 19 , the attention-based masking scheme outperforms every random and sliding-window control at temperatures 0 and 1 and at all three considered KV budgets. It is worth noting that using an attention-based mask induces additional complexity to the overall training scheme, as we need to perform an additional dense forward pass.

The underlying potential reason for the performance improvement of skewed KL is that skewed KL compensates for large model distribution discrepancies, which may follow due to the large parameter count ratio between the draft and the target. blocks.en: Appendix K Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录K 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: We review the work most directly connected to frozen prefill selection, decode-time cache management, and compressed-cache drafting.
blocks.zh: 我们审查与冻结预填选择、解码时间缓存管理以及压缩缓存起草最直接相关的工作。

blocks.en:
Prefill-based KV cache compression. A major line of work focuses on a single compression of the prompt KV cache, right before decode takes place.
SnapKV estimates prefill-token importance from attention scores produced by an observation window, often at the end of prefill Li et al. (2024) .
PyramidKV and AdaKV build SnapKV’s selection paradigm while heterogeneously allocating the cache budget across layers and heads, respectively Cai et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2025b) . Other static KV cache selectors change the importance signal. For example, CriticalKV scores the output perturbation caused by eviction Feng et al. (2026) , Expected Attention models attention under a distribution of future queries Devoto et al. (2025) and CurDKV uses query-free key and value-leverage scores Sengupta et al. (2025) .
DefensiveKV instead challenges the usual mean aggregation of importance over an observation window and introduces a worst-case-risk-aware aggregation rule. nevertheless, its eviction is still performed during prefill, leaving the retained prompt set fixed during decode Feng et al. (2025a) .
ChunkKV changes the selection unit from individual tokens to contiguous chunks Liu et al. (2025) . Collectively, these methods primarily optimize which entries survive compression. Our work studies a common failure mode: even a strong prefill decision can become stale as a long generated prefix changes what the model needs, and we do that through the lenses of speculative decoding.
In the context of compressibility training, KV-CAT Gelberg et al. (2026) demonstrates that training under KV sparsification can improve the post-hoc compressibility of pretrained language models, enabling additional gains through training. They consider an additional, trainable masker module, based on which sparse attention masks are built. In this work we directly consider specific KV scoring methods.

Decode-time KV compression for long generation. Decode-time strategies continually adapt the working cache. For example, ScissorHands exploits persistence of token importance, StreamingLLM retains attention sinks and recent tokens, and H 2 O allocates half of its cache budget to recent tokens and half to heavy-hitters identified by accumulated attention scores Liu et al. (2023) ; Xiao et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023) . R-KV utilizes reasoning trace information sparsity Cai et al. (2025) . QUEST proposes lightweight page-level retrieval through aggregated metrics Tang et al. (2024) . Its page summaries are complementary to our study of when and from which temporal region a drafter should refresh its active cache.
LongFlow derives a low-overhead importance signal from the current query for continuous eviction, whereas KARA restricts decode-time scoring to a recent window and expands selected tokens into flexible chunks Su et al. (2026) ; Han et al. (2026) .

(2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025) .
